\begin{abstract}
This informal report (not to be submitted for grading nor be a finalised report, a report meant to get an earful of learning from) focuses on the recollection of the flawed project proposition which is the "Pet shop tagging device", what went wrong and the new idea that is still in fruition. The author will then challenge this idea and somehow find that it fits the criteria of what the Module ask of the students, with the added bonus of getting used to the LaTeX syntaxes and the standard report structure required off an engineering graduate. Experiments or further discussion will be conducted on the next report.
\end{abstract}

\section{Aim and Objectives}

The aim of this report is to investigate on the author's academic setback with his project, not to be repeated it in his next attempt. The next idea will then be challenged if it has fit the module requirements of the technologies used, and whether it has (fully or partially) solved the real life issue claimed by the author whilst it being a real/revolutionary commodity and not just a roundabout to an already solved issue. 

The main objectives are:

\begin{itemize}
    \item The oversights of the previous project
    \item Reasons for the change of project idea and why the author finds the previous project infeasible.
    \item Challenges/concerns given by the Head of the Computer Engineering department on the newly proposed idea.
\end{itemize}
